source_text: In 1999 a further forty-two An. gambiae s.l. were collected from the same villages. The diagnostic PCR described above identified three individuals that were heterozygous for the kdr mutation at the sodium-channel locus. All the remaining individuals were homozygous for the wild-type susceptible allele. The three heterozygotes were all identified as An. gambiae s.s. by species ID PCR (Paskewitz & Collins, 1990).
